avoid_when: Avoid for content-heavy presentations or slides requiring charts, images, or detailed explanation.
Avoid when the opening page needs a prominent logo or full-bleed photograph.
families.description: A formal cover slide uses a wide blue title band, centered presenter details, and a small date below.
families.digest: cover with title band and presenter details
families.name: cover-hero
selection_hints: Use for a formal presentation opening with a concise title, presenter details, and date.
Choose when a restrained corporate cover with strong centered alignment is appropriate.

avoid_when: Avoid when the closing slide needs contact details, next steps, or multiple content blocks.
Avoid for content-heavy conclusions or detailed recap slides.
families.description: A minimalist closing page uses one large centered statement and generous white space to end the presentation clearly.
families.name: closing-hero
selection_hints: Use as the final slide for a concise presentation sign-off.
Choose when a single prominent closing message is sufficient.

avoid_when: Avoid when the page needs multiple data views, a timeline, or several parallel content cards.
Avoid when the visual cannot be paired with a concise explanatory text block.
families.description: A broad title sits above a balanced two-column composition with a large supporting visual on the left and explanatory text on the right.
families.digest: title with diagram and explanatory text
families.name: content-split
selection_hints: Use for explaining one concept with a prominent visual and adjacent prose.
Choose when a diagram, photograph, or illustration needs substantial textual context.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content is primarily visual or image-led.
Avoid when the information cannot be organized into a structured matrix.
families.description: A bold title introduces a large structured table, followed by a rounded callout that highlights the main takeaway.
families.digest: large comparison table with emphasis callout
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for presenting a dense structured matrix beneath a strong heading.
Choose when a table needs a prominent takeaway or interpretive callout.

avoid_when: Avoid for image-led storytelling or visual comparisons.
Avoid when content requires multiple independent panels or data views.
families.description: A conventional content slide pairs a prominent blue title band with one spacious bulleted text area.
families.digest: title band over single bullet list
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for explaining one topic through several concise bullet points.
Choose when one key point may need more detail than the others.
Suitable for straightforward informational content with a strong heading band.

avoid_when: Avoid when the agenda requires detailed descriptions, nested sections, or visual previews.
Avoid for ordinary content pages that need charts, images, or explanatory text.
families.description: A straightforward agenda page presents a prominent top-band heading above a spacious numbered section list.
families.digest: simple agenda with numbered section list
families.name: agenda-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a concise table of contents near the beginning of a presentation.
Best for roughly three to six short section names in a single vertical list.
